description:
pkix-identity/src/lib.rs: `ServerName` and `MailboxName` gained `FromStr` impls (lines 310-315, 470-476) but have no `Display` impl. This violates the Rust convention that `FromStr` and `Display` are a matched pair — if you can parse a string into a type, you should be able to format the type back to a string. Without `Display`, callers cannot log or display these types without reaching into the internal structure via accessors. The types are public and cache-friendly (they derive `Serialize`), so they will appear in diagnostic contexts.

Suggested fix: implement `Display` for both. `ServerName` should print the DNS name or IP literal; `MailboxName` should print `local@domain`.
title: ServerName and MailboxName implement FromStr but not Display
